_comment: Root fallback config. Every app, service and package that matters carries
its own tsconfig.json — apps/, packages/gallery, packages/federation,
packages/workspace and shell/ extend tsconfig.base.json (the browser /
Svelte profile); services/ extend tsconfig.services.json (the Node
profile). This one only governs the leftovers and gives editors something
to resolve against for files no other project claims.
THE RULE FOR `exclude`: it must name every directory that carries its own
tsconfig.json. A directory with its own config that is missing from this
list gets type-checked TWICE, under two different sets of options, and
nothing fails loudly to tell you.
That is not hypothetical — it was the state of this file until 2026-09-13.
The list named packages/federation and packages/workspace and forgot
packages/gallery, so gallery's five source files were checked both by their
own config and by this one, which adds noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters
and omits types: ['svelte']. The comment below claimed the file governed
one file while tsc --listFiles reported six. Verify with --listFiles after
changing this list; do not trust the prose, including this prose.
The leftovers are currently ONE file — packages/theme/mode-switcher.ts.
scripts/ and tools/ are .mjs. Kept rather than deleted because a monorepo
root without a tsconfig degrades editor resolution for loose files, and the
next stray .ts lands here by default.
packages/shared-ui joined the exclude list on 2026-09-13. The line above
used to read "and packages/shared-ui is .svelte only", which was true when
written and stopped being true the moment that package gained its gallery
catalog — three .ts files under src/gallery/. S1 caught it on the first run
after, which is the whole argument for the check: the prose in this file had
been correct and became wrong without anyone touching it.
NO REACT, NO JSX RUNTIME. This file used to set jsx: 'react-jsx' — the
single React reference anywhere in the repository, against a hard
prohibition (see the astro-knots skill: Astro + Svelte for interactivity,
never React). There has never been a .tsx or .jsx file here and react has
never been a dependency, so it was pure vestige from a scaffold.
jsx: 'preserve' keeps .tsx syntactically legal without binding any
runtime — TypeScript type-checks it and emits the JSX untouched for a
bundler to handle. TSX as a file format is fine; React is not.
Target raised ES2020 -> ES2022 to match every other config in the repo.
The old value was wrong for the code it nominally covers: services use
Object.hasOwn and logical-assignment operators, which are ES2022.
The @/*, @packages/* and @apps/* path aliases were removed — verified
unused by every .ts, .svelte and .mjs file in the repo. Workspace imports
go through the @augment-it/* package names instead.
